desc:
🧪 Welcome to the Lab! 🤖 Test dummies are ready for experiments, and strange creatures 👹 roam the halls.

Play as yourself with a set of lab tools 🔧, or transform into one of many playable creatures 🐺, each with its own abilities ✨.

🎯 Physics playground: launch, bounce and toss dummies around the lab.
👾 Many playable creatures, each with unique moves.
🔓 Unlock new tools as you play.
🌪️ World events like tornadoes, meteor showers ☄️ and low gravity 🌙.
🎪 Stunt areas with a cannon 💣, trampoline, wrecking ball and tower 🗼.
⏪ Rewind and slow motion ⏱️ to replay your best moments.
🎁 Daily gifts and playtime rewards.

Plays on PC 💻, mobile 📱, tablet and 🎮console.
